Leyland Trade Contract is a brilliant white, high-opacity matt emulsion paint designed for interior walls and ceilings. This water-based paint is ideal for trade professionals and DIYers working on new plasterwork, commercial renovations, and residential refurbishments. This easy-to-use paint can be applied with a brush, roller, or spray. It dries quickly, becoming touch-dry and ready for a second coat in just 2 to 4 hours. With a coverage rate of 13m²/Ltr, this low VOC paint delivers a clean finish.
